clue.text: Element used by William Butler

indicators.note: used by says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A note on some element of style employed by the poet W. B. Yeats.
explanation.definitionFit: An iamb is a metrical foot, one basic building unit of a line of verse.

clue.text: Confused measure — speak right out

parts.note: an inch is a measure of length

indicators.note: out says that piece is removed from the word

parts.note: to orate is to speak formally

explanation.surface: A muddled amount, so speak up properly.
explanation.definitionFit: Inchoate means only partly formed and so disordered or incoherent, close to confused.

clue.text: Manipulator of body has to employ sharp stroke on top

indicators.note: on top in a down clue puts this piece above the other

parts.note: a masse is a billiards stroke with the cue held steeply to make the ball swerve
to employ is to use

explanation.surface: A physio has to use a sharp blow from above.
explanation.walkthrough: MASSE (massé) is a billiards stroke played with the cue near vertical.
explanation.definitionFit: A masseuse is a woman who massages, kneading and manipulating the body.

clue.text: Rogues treating port as beer

indicators.note: treating suggests processing or working on material, so these letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Scoundrels who pass off port as if it were ordinary beer.
explanation.definitionFit: Reprobates are unprincipled people, a direct synonym for rogues.

clue.text: Bird of a particular colour that is ascending

indicators.note: ascending in a down clue means reading the pieces upwards, backwards

parts.note: red is one particular colour
ie abbreviates id est, that is

explanation.surface: A bird of a certain shade that is rising.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ascending' turns RED + IE upwards, giving EIDER.
explanation.definitionFit: The eider is a large sea duck, prized for its soft down.

clue.text: See guerrilla fighter in listing

indicators.note: in places the fighter inside the list

parts.note: a roster is a list of names
Che Guevara was the famous guerrilla leader

explanation.surface: Spot a guerrilla in a list of names.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like a verb; it is a bishop's diocese. Rochester is an English cathedral city in Kent.
explanation.definitionFit: A see is a bishop's diocese, and Rochester is one of the Church of England's ancient sees.

clue.text: Get mum fastening on bottom of the garment

parts.note: a button is a fastening on clothes
taken as written

indicators.note: bottom of points to the last letter of the next word

parts.note: a slip is a woman's undergarment

explanation.surface: Put a button on the lower part of the dress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mum' is not mother here but silent.
explanation.definitionFit: To button one's lip is to keep quiet, an idiom for falling silent or getting mum.

clue.text: Shoot to get money box, having little hesitation

parts.note: a till is a cash drawer or box
er is the small sound of hesitating

explanation.surface: Shoot someone to grab the cash box, after a brief pause.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shoot' looks like firing a gun; it is a sprouting plant stem.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiller is a botanical term for a shoot growing from the base of a plant.

clue.text: Bandage the man's given after hit

indicators.note: given after places this piece following the other

parts.note: to swat is to hit sharply
the man is he, and the 's stands for is, a link

explanation.surface: A man is bandaged up after being struck.
explanation.definitionFit: To swathe is to wrap in bandages or cloth.

clue.text: Clown was one of the top actors about to be ditched

indicators.note: ditched says a piece is thrown out of the longer word

parts.words: was one of the top actors
parts.note: to be one of a film's leading players alongside another is to have costarred
re is a short Latin-derived word meaning about or concerning

explanation.surface: A clown who once shared top billing finds himself on the way to being dropped.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing RE from COSTARRED leaves COSTARD; Costard is the clown in Shakespeare's Love's Labour's Lost.
explanation.definitionFit: Costard is the name of a Shakespearean clown, so the word serves as a literary example of one.

clue.text: Cuts evident in the BBC and ITV, say

definitions.text: Cuts evident in the BBC and ITV, say

parts.words: Cuts evident in the BBC and ITV, say
parts.note: the broadcaster names are shortened forms, each word cut to its initial

explanation.surface: Budget cuts at the two big British broadcasters are plain to see.
explanation.walkthrough: Cuts look like budget reductions; they are shortened words. BBC and ITV are British TV channels.
explanation.definitionFit: Shortened forms of words, like initials standing for names, are cut-down versions of them.

clue.text: Animal comes to mountain by a tree

parts.note: a cat is a common animal
an alp is a high mountain

explanation.surface: A creature reaches a mountainside and settles beside a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The catalpa is a flowering tree with large heart-shaped leaves and long bean-like pods.

clue.text: Dreadful boor never subdued

indicators.note: dreadful hints the letters are in a terrible state and need putting right

explanation.surface: An awful lout who has never been tamed.
explanation.definitionFit: Overborne means overwhelmed or suppressed, so it carries the sense of being subdued.

clue.text: African sorcery? Old rubbish taking English in!

indicators.note: taking, with in after it, says one piece takes another into itself

parts.note: bah is an exclamation of contempt, like saying rubbish!

explanation.surface: Someone scoffs at African witchcraft as old nonsense, yet takes it in.
explanation.definitionFit: Obeah is a folk magic or sorcery of West African origin practised in the Caribbean; the question mark covers that.

clue.text: Two girls into running around and getting fit

parts.note: Tess is a girl's name
Ella is a second girl's name

indicators.note: running around suggests the following word is jumbled up as it runs about

explanation.surface: A pair of girls take up jogging to get into shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting fit' looks like the girls' aim in the surface, but it is the definition: shapes fitting together.
explanation.definitionFit: Tessellation is the fitting together of shapes with no gaps, as in tiling.

clue.text: Influential agent going to secure introductions for each novelist

indicators.note: to secure means holding something inside

parts.note: leaving is going away

indicators.note: introductions point to the opening letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A powerful agent heading off to arrange intros for each writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Leavening is a substance that spreads through and transforms dough, figuratively any pervasive influence.

clue.text: Fish in principal location, river, openly visible

parts.note: a seat, as in seat of government, is a main location
out means in the open, visible

explanation.surface: Fish found in the main spot of the river, plain to see.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea trout is a migratory form of brown trout, a kind of fish.

clue.text: Fish making tongues wag whopper finally caught

indicators.note: caught means held within the jumbled letters
tongues that wag move about, so the word's letters shift around
finally points to the last letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: A fish story sets tongues wagging after a big one is caught.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wag' jumbles TONGUES, and 'caught' puts R from whopper inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The sturgeon is a large fish, famous as the source of caviar.

clue.text: Drunk denigrates me, resulting in quarrel

indicators.note: drunk suggests letters staggering out of order

explanation.surface: A drinker insults me, and a row breaks out.
explanation.definitionFit: A disagreement is an argument or falling-out, which is what a quarrel is.

clue.text: One provides preliminary heat for contestants

definitions.text: One provides preliminary heat for contestants

parts.words: One provides preliminary heat for contestants
parts.note: heat suggests a first-round race, but it is bodily warmth produced by light exercise before competing

explanation.surface: A qualifying round is laid on before the main event.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heat' looks like a qualifying round; it is warmth.
explanation.definitionFit: A warm-up is gentle exercise done to raise the body's temperature before competition.

clue.text: Fine a draper not giving full length

indicators.note: means the last letter is lost

parts.note: a mercer is a dealer in textiles

explanation.surface: A cloth merchant is penalised for selling short measures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fine' looks like an adjective; it is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To amerce is an old legal word meaning to punish with a fine.

clue.text: Take on commercial institute in America

parts.note: a commercial is an advertisement, ad for short
MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, in the USA

explanation.surface: An American institute hires someone through a commercial.
explanation.definitionFit: To admit someone is to take them on, as a member, student or patient.

clue.text: One may move on to another American story

definitions.text: One may move on to another American story

parts.words: One may move on to another American story
parts.note: story is the American spelling of storey, a floor of a building; the moving staircase carries you up to the next floor

explanation.surface: A tale that leads into a further American tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'story' looks like a tale; it is the US spelling of storey, a building's floor.
explanation.definitionFit: A moving staircase carries shoppers from one floor of a building up to the next.

clue.text: In the country, relocating a group of shops here

indicators.note: relocating says one letter is moved elsewhere in the word

parts.note: China is a large country

explanation.surface: A retail group is setting up in that country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'relocating a' moves the A of CHINA to a new spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A chain is a group of shops under common ownership.

clue.text: Radio engineer hurt —— disadvantage with electrical current?

parts.note: to mar is to damage or hurt
con as in pros and cons, a point against
I is the physics symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: A radio pioneer wonders whether he was harmed by some drawback of electricity.
explanation.definitionFit: Guglielmo Marconi was the Italian engineer who pioneered long-distance radio transmission.

clue.text: After setback dad gets to turn out OK

indicators.note: setback read literally as set back, put the word backwards, and after placing it first

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
to turn out a certain way is to prove so

explanation.surface: Following a reverse, father's plans end up all right.
explanation.definitionFit: To approve something is to OK it, give it the go-ahead.

clue.text: Try to persuade a fellow to be a publicist

parts.note: to press someone is to urge or try to persuade them
gent is short for gentleman, a fellow

explanation.surface: Lean on a man to take on promotional work.
explanation.definitionFit: A press agent is employed to get publicity for a client, so is a type of publicist.

clue.text: Shock when daring act isn't completed

indicators.note: not completed means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a stunt is a daring feat

explanation.surface: Spectators are stunned when a daredevil fails to finish the feat.
explanation.definitionFit: To stun is to shock or daze someone, a direct synonym.
